test_check_estimator: test an estimator against the full scikit-learn API compatibility suite
test_parametrize_with_checks: test multiple estimators using a pytest decorator that generates parametrized checks
test_estimator_checks_generator: test an estimator by iterating over all applicable check callables
test_check_array_api_input: test that an estimator works consistently with Array API namespaces and devices
test_check_sample_weights_equivalence: test that fitting with sample weights is equivalent to fitting with repeated or removed samples
